title: Shiraishi An — Assistant Screenwriter〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Lunch break
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yes, it's finally lunchtime!
I'm starved!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Kusanagi, wanna have lunch toge—

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Oh, she's really focused on that notebook on her desk... Is it the screenplay for our film...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Maybe something's giving her trouble...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kusanagi! Is something wrong? You look concerned.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, Shiraishi...
So, um... I was just working on the screenplay for our film...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I'm having trouble hammering out all the little details behind the hero's personality.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: His personality...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I don't know much about screenwriting, but it still doesn't feel right having her do all the work...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, wanna try thinking about that together?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I don't know much about this stuff, but I'm sure we'll be able to come up with some good ideas if we put our heads together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I agree. Thanks, Shiraishi. I was pretty stuck, so if you don't mind brainstorming with me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! The hero's a cook, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah.
The plot involves him fighting against a bunch of baddies to protect a girl who's trying to deliver food to her sick mom.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, okay...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: People who fight to protect others usually have a strong sense of justice, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, there's that...
But he'd still be missing something...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He's a cook, so I wanna make him feel more like a real one, you know?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Which is where I got stuck.
What does that even mean?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: More like a real cook, huh...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If it were up to me, I'd want him to sound mature and have a strong sense of will...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. Someone who's always there for you. The type of person you can really count on!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, but that's not the only thing! He takes his craft really seriously and doesn't compromise on it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Like one of those baristas who inspect each bean before turning them into coffee! He cares about the little details, and that's what makes his food so delicious.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I see. He's someone you can count on...
He takes cooking more seriously than anyone, and doesn't compromise on it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup! So, for example...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
“I'm a cook.
Each grain of salt I use must be perfect.”
Something like that?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yeah, okay.
But I'd like to make him sound a little more impassioned if possible.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: More impassioned?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, uhh...
Because everyone in this class is really talkative and outgoing...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I feel that a character who says what he's thinking in a straightforward manner would make it easier for our lead.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, good point...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, more emotion...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: “My purpose in life is to make the best food I can for the people who need it!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: “I'll have no choice but to toss you lot into my cauldron along with those ingredients if you refuse to yield!” How's that...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A cauldron...? He's starting to sound more like a witch than a cook.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. True.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kusanagi...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Having him say what he's really feeling straight out like that might make him sound cooler...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Actually, in that case...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Sounds like a good idea just popped into her head...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm glad what I said helped her out a little.)

rows.Speaker: An & Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?! Lunch is over already?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm so sorry. I didn't mean to take up so much of your time...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, that's totally okay!
I was the one who asked first.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Still, what to do about lunch...
Maybe I can just eat while using a textbook as a blind like the boys do.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
A-Are you sure you want to...?
What if something gets stuck in your throat?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh...
Good point...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait a second...
Why don't we just eat after class is over?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We won't have much time, but I wanna have lunch with you! What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, okay...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Awesome! That's a promise, okay?!
